entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: ¶<<A Song, a Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the chief Musician. Upon Mahalath Leannoth. An instruction. Of Heman the Ezrahite.>> Jehovah, God of my salvation, I have cried by day [and] in the night before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer come before thee; incline thine ear unto my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draweth nigh to Sheol.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no strength:

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: Prostrate among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave; whom thou rememberest no more, and who are cut off from thy hand.

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the deeps.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: Thy fury lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: Thou hast put my familiar friends far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: Mine eye consumeth by reason of affliction. Upon thee, Jehovah, have I called every day; I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: ¶Wilt thou do wonders to the dead? shall the shades arise and praise thee? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Shall thy loving-kindness be declared in the grave? thy faithfulness in Destruction?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But as for me, Jehovah, I cry unto thee, and in the morning my prayer cometh before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: Why, O Jehovah, castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I am afflicted and expiring from my youth up; I suffer thy terrors, [and] I am distracted.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: Thy fierce anger hath gone over me; thy terrors have brought me to nought:

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They have surrounded me all the day like water; they have compassed me about together.

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: Lover and associate hast thou put far from me: my familiar friends are darkness.
